QuestInfo.name: Fighting for Control
QuestInfo.0: The darkness fills you with rage. Maybe you can't control it yet.
QuestInfo.1: You just need a release. Try taking out your anger on #b40 Evil Eyes#k at the Giant Tree.
QuestInfo.2: You've regained a little bit of control. Return to the Magic Library and find a way to get to Harmony.

0.1: But for now, I need to vent some of my rage...

yes.0: I don't care for the way those #bEvil Eyes#k look at me. I'll just slay 40 of them or so.

no.0: Perhaps I will simply bottle up my anger forever. This seems like a good plan.

0.0: Unbelievable! Have I so little control of my Dark powers? Am I such a grave danger to those around me? I don't even have the power to bring the child back from where I sent him! For now, I must reach Harmony, where I will be alone. I'm a danger to everyone around me...

yes.0: Now to return to the Magic Library for some more research on Aurora.\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n
